name: Trundle

source.concept: Stone pill-bug: arched three-segment shell, one big eye, six stubby legs.

behavior_contract: turns around at walls and ledges
stomp from above: defeated, player bounces
any other contact: player restarts at checkpoint
frozen at its placed spot outside runs; resets to its placed spot each attempt
immune to normal damage (only course rules defeat it)
